title: This Fish Shoots Insects Off Branches and Predicts Where They Land
subject: archerfish

scenes.text: A fish shoots an insect off a branch, then races to catch it.
It's the archerfish. It fires a jet of water at prey up to three meters above the surface.
Even targets six body lengths away get hit almost as hard as close ones.
But the shot is only half the problem. The insect falls, and rival fish are racing for it.
So the archerfish works out where the falling insect will land, and starts moving in about 40 milliseconds.
Scientists compare it to a baseball outfielder judging a fly ball. This one is a fish.
